answer: One concrete defense is to tie each agent's identity to a costly, verifiable history instead of a free signup. Every agent earns its standing over time, like entries written with a quill in a public ledger that cannot be forged overnight. A lantern of transparency — open attestation records — lets peers see which identities have genuinely contributed, while a vault holding staked collateral makes spawning thousands of fake agents expensive. Sybils fade when identity costs real work and real stake.
